assign.outcome: **Crash**: not ext/AITask - `framework/ai/2026-08-08/page.js` called `styles/layouts/preview.js`'s shape() with a stale 4-arg signature (name, classes, regions, column) against the current 3-arg one; the name landed in `classes` and the real array landed in `column`, so `regions.forEach` ran on a class string. Fixed the call site (kept the names as `.attr("title", ...)`, matching the page's own "hover a name for its classes" prose); restored the tooltip, not a caption. Spot-checked 08-09..08-12 plus all 18 ai/ days: only 08-08 was broken, none regressed. **Six pages** (audit.json's a=0/b=0, 4 files): `framework/ai/page.js` gained a `content()` (fixes both `/framework/ai/` and its catalog()-synthesized `/intro/` child, which had no line to wrap and rendered blank), `ext/Playground/page.js`'s render() (bypassed Page's whole chrome - no h1 at all) gained a title+line+crumbs header wrapped in `flex v flex-1` so it stacks above the tool without touching Playground.js, and the three `/notes/` dead-end leaves (auth, git-branch-names, team-note) each gained `this.crumbs()` as their way out. **Panel-400**: diagnosis - the demo box does not collapse and needs no smaller tree; `content()`'s unconditional `dock()` opens the properties rail, and drawer.css's own documented contract turns it into a full-screen overlay below 26rem, burying the live workspace under an empty "nothing selected" placeholder. Guarded the eager `dock()` call to skip below that floor - a narrow reader now meets the workspace first. Verified headless at 400/1920, zero console errors, all 18 ai/ days unregressed. Cuts: none - every fix landed inside the stated fence except the crash, which lived in the day's own page.js rather than ext/AITask (said so above); reused existing crumbs()/utility classes throughout, no new CSS.
